In some patients the use of amitriptyline with fluconazole has led to syncope3 or torsade de pointes.4 Raised serum concen- trations of nortriptyline and associated symptoms of intoxication have been reported in 2 patients during treatment with terbin- afine;5,6 the interaction was confirmed on rechallenge. In another case, dizziness, dry mouth, and muscle twitching were reported in a patient on long-term imipramine treatment after starting ter- binafine;7 serum imipramine concentrations were found to be el- evated and symptoms subsided after the dose of imipramine was reduced.
